title: tc-sla-status
description:
Service-level performance – the on-time share, a Met / At risk / Breached split in words and marks, a weekly trend,
per-type rows and a period chooser.

split.description: The counts for the whole period

rows.description: Counts per type of request, each drawn as its own bar

trend.description: The on-time share per week, oldest first, from 0 to 1

labels.description: The outcomes' names, merged over the defaults (Met, At risk, Breached)

periods.description: The periods to choose from; empty hides the chooser

period.description: The period shown. Changed by the user unless a tc-period-change listener calls preventDefault()

unit.description: What the counts are, after the number: "12 requests"

locale.description: The language for numbers, e.g. "de"; by default the browser's

SlaRow.description: A type of request with its own split
